## What stands out

- OoT is 155 of 202 reports. Build 93 is the most reported (117), build 95 second (55) and build 88 third (12).
- Status mix: 85 Playable, 66 Runs, 21 Unplayable, 17 Loads, 13 Perfect.
- NVIDIA reports are 63/114 Playable or Perfect. AMD is 20/49. Intel and Apple samples are too small to rank.
- Windows is 139 reports, Linux 37, macOS 5.
- 92 reports mention an FPS number. OoT FPS mentions run from 10 to 120 FPS. Scene, shader compilation and frame generation explain most of the spread.
- Shader mentions are the most common technical theme (117 reports), followed by crashes (60) and stutter (58).

## Source and limits

- Source: [Lichii public reports](https://lichii.zortos.me/reports). The scraper reads the sitemap and the public report pages only.
- It does not call the authenticated or disallowed API endpoints, and it waits between requests.
- The site labels are subjective and the reports are not controlled tests. One report is an anecdote.
